label: Version
description: The app's version, read from its single version source.

label: Build commit
description: Short git commit hash (max 12 chars) stamped at build time; "dev" when running from source.

label: Build date
description: UTC build date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601) stamped at build time; "unknown" when running from source.

label: OS
description: Operating system family: Linux, macOS or Windows.

label: Kernel
description: Kernel release or OS build number.

label: Architecture
description: CPU architecture, e.g. aarch64, x86_64, AMD64.

label: Device
description: Hardware model, e.g. from /proc/device-tree/model on Raspberry Pi; "unknown" if absent.

label: Key dependencies
description: List of name=version for the app's important dependencies; "none" if empty.

label: Data dir
description: Where the app stores its data; "n/a" if the app has none.

label: Config dir
description: Where the app reads its config; "n/a" if the app has none.

label: Log dir
description: Where the app writes logs; "n/a" if the app has none.

label: AI provider
description: Configured AI provider name(s) only, never keys or credentialed URLs; "n/a" if unused.

label: AI model
description: Configured AI model name(s) only; "n/a" if unused.

label: Timezone
description: Local timezone name and UTC offset, e.g. "IST (UTC+05:30)".
